shared_elements: upright rectangular slab/stela format with figural scene
script or sign blocks integrated with the imagery
low relief carving of figures with headgear/ornament
offering or ritual scene with objects held
justification: Both are upright monumental slabs bearing a figural relief combined with blocks of writing, and both show ritual/ceremonial human figures with headdresses and held objects — but these are generic monument conventions. A shows a small-scale, thin-limbed family group in profile beneath a rayed disc above many horizontal lines of text, whereas B is dominated by a single frontal, massively costumed figure whose elaborate deep-relief regalia fills nearly the whole field with only marginal sign columns, so the figure scale, viewpoint, and text-to-image relationship differ entirely.
